title: Manage Annual Exercise Plan
acceptance_criteria: 14.8.1 System shall restrict by ReqCens according to the respective Controller’s access rights.
14.8.2 System shall display a summary of all ReqCens, the ReqCen Description, Previous and Last Exercise Dates and the Planned Exercise Workyear (e.g. WY 2025).
14.8.3 System shall update the Previous and Last CR Exercise Dates automatically after ReqCen has completed their CR exercise.

14.8.4 System shall derive the Planned Exercise Workyear for each ReqCen taking reference from its last exercise dates. A mapping table shall be set-up to define the mapping logic for Planned Exercise Workyear. For example, the planned exercise workyear for ReqCen A is +3 years from its last exercise date.
14.8.5 Controllers shall be able to amend the Planned Exercise Workyear for ReqCens that he/she is authorised to.

14.8.6 Upon clicking onto the respective ReqCen’s previous or last CR exercise date, system shall display the exercise scale, i.e. the number of CR owners and the number of CR assets participated in that exercise.

title: Manage CR Owners Information
acceptance_criteria: 14.12.1 The CR Owners shall be segregated into ‘Allocated CR Owners’ and ‘Unallocated CR Owners’. a. b. Allocated CR Owners. They can be allocated to one or more ReqCens. They are generally termed as shared CR Owner if the company is supporting more than one ReqCen. Controllers shall be able to view all records regardless of ReqCens. He/She shall be able to view when the CR Owner was last mobilised. For shared CR Owner, the last mobilisation date for each ReqCen shall be shown. Unallocated CR Owners. Controllers shall be able to view all the records. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)

14.12.2 Header information shall include UEN number, Company Name, Status of the company, Mailing Address, Office/Site Address, GST Registration Number, Office Contact Number, Other Contact Number (e.g. Mobile Number), Email Address etc.

14.12.3 ReqCen-level information shall include CR Owner’s POC names, their mobile number, office number, fax number and email address. There shall also be a display checkbox to indicate who are the primary and secondary POCs.

14.12.4 Controllers shall be able to view the CR Owners’ assets which shall be grouped and presented logically. a. ‘CR Assets Owned’ shall show each CR category and their respective Quantity. It shall provide the total number of CR assets of the CR Owner. b. ‘CR Category Allocated to ReqCens’ shall show the CR category, Quantity Allocated and ReqCen Allocated. It shall provide the allocation to ownership ratio. E.g. if a CR Owner owns 10 assets and only 5 are allocated, the allocation ratio is 50%. c. ‘ReqCen Allocation History’ shall show the Allocation Date and the corresponding ReqCen. It shall provide a summary of the total allocation records. d. ‘De-allocation History’ shall show the De-allocation Date and the corresponding ReqCen and Reason for De-allocation.

14.12.5 Controllers shall be able to view the CR Mobilisation Exercise History of each CR Owner. The information shall include ReqCen, Requisition Plan Description, Requisition Plan Type, Mobilisation Date.
14.12.6 Controllers shall be able to view additional information related to Shared CR Owners status. The information shall include Major ReqCen and Shared ReqCens.
14.12.7 Controllers shall be able to view all the CR assets of the CR Owners. Information shall include CR Type, CR Category, Registration Number, Chassis Number, Engine Number, etc.
14.12.8 System shall have a function to download a template containing all the essential fields that shall be populated to support mass load CR Owner Details into CRIPS.
14.12.9 System shall have a function to download all the CR assets of the CR Owners.

14.12.10 System shall have a function to download all the CR Owners details. There shall be controls to restrict the number of records that can be downloaded each time. This control shall be managed via App Setting or Site Properties.
14.12.11 Controllers shall be able to export/download the information.
14.12.12 Controllers shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.

title: Dashboard

title: Manage Undertaking Approvals
acceptance_criteria: 15.1.1 Upon a Requesting Agency’s submission of a request to register a firm, system shall send an email notification to the Lead Agency for allocation. Of note, Controller Undertakings shall be included in the list of Lead Agency.
15.1.2 For cases where CRO(Undertaking) selects Controller Undertakings as the Lead Agency, Controller Undertakings shall be able to allocate and reject agency’s requests routed to him/her.

15.1.3 Controller Undertakings shall be able to allocate a company to the request if no preferred company is not indicated in the request. If Controller Undertakings rejects the request, system shall prompt him/her to enter the reason for rejecting the request.

15.1.4 System shall send an email notification to inform Controller Undertakings of the request pending his/her approval, after MHA Office updates in CRIPS the firm’s security clearance is successful. Of note, MHA Office may indicate an expiry date for the security clearance. a. If MHA Office indicate the expiry date as “31-12-9999”, it means no expiry date.
15.1.5 For other dates, CRO(Undertaking) or Controller Undertakings Office shall initiate security re-clearance at least 2 months before the security clearance expiry date.

15.1.6 System shall have a workflow to allow CRO(Undertaking) or Controller Undertakings Office to submit for security re-clearance. The re-clearance requests could be due to changes in the firm’s senior management or expiry set by MHA Office.

15.1.7 Controller Undertakings shall be able to approve and reject agency’s requests to de- register an approved firm. If he/she approves the request, the firm shall be deallocated from the requesting agency. If Controller Undertakings rejects the request, system shall prompt him/her to enter the reason for rejecting the request.
15.1.8 After de-allocation, if there is only one agency that requires the firm, system shall update it from ‘Shared’ to ‘Individual’ firm.

15.1.9 System shall enable Controller Undertakings to display all undertaking requirements pending his/her action, a. ‘Allocation’ – It shall display requirements with ‘Pending Approval’ status. b. ‘De-Allocation’ – It shall display requirements with ‘Pending De-Allocation Approval’ status.
15.1.10 System shall enable Controller Undertakings to process the request individually.

This report gives an overview of the status of requests for companies/firms by the requesting agency. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Lead Agency, Submission From Dates and Current Status. b. Essential Firms (by Agency) Report. This report generates the list of firms by Requesting Agencies. When generating the report, Controller Undertakings shall be able to select the period and registration status (e.g. all status, rejected, deregistered firms). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Lead Agency and Allocated From Dates. c. Essential Firms (by Company) Report. This report generates the list of firms by company/firm. The report shall show if the Company is ‘Individual’ or ‘Shared’, and if it is ‘Shared’, it shall show the list of agencies that have registered the company. When generating the report, users shall be able to select the period and registration status (e.g. all status, rejected, deregistered firms). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Coordinating Agency and the Allocated from dates. d. Undertakings Readiness (by Agency) Report. This report generates a summary of firms’ readiness covering the E-Plan and Exercise status by Requesting Agencies. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm and the range of the approval dates. e. Undertakings Readiness (by Company) Report. This report generates a summary of firms’ readiness covering the E-Plan and Exercise status by OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)

17.1.2 System shall display all RORCB cases and grouped them by tabs according to the status of each case, i.e. 'Open’, ‘Pending’, and 'Closed'.

17.1.3 For Asset cases, system shall display details such as CR Owner Name and its UEN, CR Category, Appeal Type, First Offer (S$) and GST Amount (S$), Appeal Amount (S$) and GST Amount (S$), Second Offer (S$) and GST Amount (S$).

17.1.4 For Undertaking cases, system shall display details such as the Company/Firm Name and its UEN, Service Category, Appeal Type, First Offer (S$) and GST Amount (S$), Appeal Amount (S$) and GST Amount (S$), Second Offer (S$) and GST Amount (S$).

title: Login to CR Owner Portal
acceptance_criteria: 18.1.1 Upon clicking on ‘Login’ button, system shall require CR owner to login as a Corppass user, i.e. CR owner must have a valid Corppass ID and password for logging in to the CR Owner Portal.
18.1.2 System shall block non-allocated CR owners from accessing the CR owner portal.
18.1.3 System shall have ‘Logout’ button to allow CR owners to logout of the portal.
18.1.4 System shall display the CR owner last login to the CR owner portal.
18.1.5 System shall be able to track CR owner login, the corresponding timestamp as well as the audit logs of CR owner’s actions.

title: CR Owner Information and Contact Details
acceptance_criteria: 18.2.1 CR Owner shall be able to submit, update, view, verify the company details and contact information. There should be fields such as the company’s UEN, handphone number, office number, registered company mailing address, email address, GST registration status, POC contact details.
18.2.2 CR Owner shall be able to assign multiple point-of-contact (POC) to receive notices and notification for CR requisition. CR Owner can update the contact information of the POC.
18.2.3 System shall have a section on ‘Contact and Notification Preferences’ and include a ‘View/Edit’ function. a. b. c. System shall list all the ReqCens supported by the CR owner.
18.2.4 For each ReqCen, system shall display a message to state ‘You will receive SMS notification sent to [POCs], [mobile numbers] and email notification at [email addresses].

18.2.5 Upon clicking on the ‘View/Edit button’, system shall allow toggle between ‘View’ and ‘Edit’ mode. d. e. CR Owner shall be allowed to select ‘SMS’, ‘Email’ and ‘SMS and Email’ as the mode of notifications. System shall require CR Owner to click on the checkbox to consent to the Terms and Conditions of Use and agree to receive digital notices and notifications. The Terms and Conditions of Use shall be embedded with hyperlink to bring him/her to a page with relevant information.
18.2.6 The content on this page shall be configurable easily via Service Request.

title: Notices, Orders, Directions and Requisition published in the CR Owner Portal
acceptance_criteria: 18.3.1 For new notifications, CR owner shall be able to click ‘Acknowledge’ in the system.
18.3.2 The system shall also track and update the status to ‘Acknowledged’. System shall log and display the timestamp of the acknowledgment.

18.3.3 System shall be able to mark the notifications as ‘Read’ once the CR owner view the message, i.e. even without clicking the ‘Acknowledge’ button, the status shall be updated to ‘Read’. System shall log and display the timestamp of when the notification was read.
18.3.4 CR owner shall be able to view and re-open past notifications even though they have been read and/or acknowledged.

18.3.5 System shall list the notifications according to the timestamp it was sent and display the most recent notifications on top of the list. New notifications that have not been read shall be have a ‘New’ icon to highlight/draw attention. System shall also show the total number of new notifications.

title: Resources Earmarked for Requisition
acceptance_criteria: 18.4.1 For ‘Exercise’ and ‘Operation’ Requisition Plans, system shall auto generate and send emails, informing the CR Owners that they have been selected to participate in an upcoming CR requisition.

18.4.2 CR owner shall be able to retrieve such notifications via the CR Owner Portal. He/She shall be able to view the pertinent details such as the period that they could be activated, the types of CR assets and quantity required for requisition, the primary and alternate EMA address, and contact details of the CROs, name and appointment of the Competent Authority. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)
18.4.3 CR Owner shall be able to use the appropriate functions in the CR Owner Portal to inform the CROs on the availability of the allocated CR assets when assets not serviceable.

18.4.4 CR Owner shall be able to use the appropriate functions in the CR Owner Portal to notify the CROs of changes in their heavy plant assets. For example, new heavy plants acquired and existing heavy plants that have been sold or disposed.
